notes: No official Montenegrin register with phones/hours was readable: gov.me pages of the Uprava za bezbjednost hrane, veterinu i fitosanitarne poslove only expose document titles (the clinic list is a 19 MB docx without an accessible link), and no Veterinarska komora Crne Gore page was found. No duty rota (dežurstvo) and no animal poison line found for Montenegro. Only Hasvet (Podgorica) states 24/7. The WebFetch tool could only open URLs that appeared in earlier results, and animavet.me forbids automated access (robots), canis.me loops on redirect and vetport.me failed to load, so these clinics rely on the CG Stray / Kotor Kitties NGO pages. Left to do: Budva and Kotor additional clinics, Nikšić others, Bijelo Polje, Pljevlja, Kolašin/Žabljak, Berane, Danilovgrad, Rožaje, Bar/Ulcinj others (only planplus.rs aggregator listings found, not used); Univerzitet Crne Gore has no veterinary faculty hospital; clinic own sites for Adria Vet, Vet Medica, Novi Vet, PetVet, MedicusVet (Instagram/Facebook only). Run 2 (2026-11-04): added 3 Bijelo Polje clinics from the municipality's official phone list. Nothing verifiable found for Pljevlja, Berane, Rožaje, Kolašin, Žabljak, Danilovgrad (only companywall/ekapija/planplus aggregator listings; gov.me veterinary documents are PDFs whose content WebFetch cannot read: 'Veterinarske ambulante - dopis' 2022, 'VA Berane Petnjica' 2019); more Budva/Ulcinj/Nikšić/Bar clinics have no own site found (Budva only Vet Medica, already listed). No duty rota or poison line found (balkanica.me emergency page has only human numbers).
